title: Mechanical Multi-Service Credit: Workmanship Warranties Truth Table
content:
Under the Workmanship Warranties, a mechanical multi-service credit is taken off the mechanical diagnostic charge on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty. The mechanical multi-service credit follows the customer's payments, less than the multi-service window months of 36 whole calendar months before the charge date, on the customer's network calibration orders under ADAS Sensor Calibrations and on the customer's network rentals under Rental Vehicle Coordination: at least one calibration payment and at least one rental payment, the two-service credit of USD 15.00; at least one calibration payment and no rental payment, the calibration-only credit of USD 7.50; any other combination, no mechanical multi-service credit.

## Truth table

| Customer payments on ADAS Sensor Calibrations orders in the window | Customer payments on Rental Vehicle Coordination rentals in the window | Mechanical multi-service credit |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | one or more | USD 15.00 |
| one or more | none | USD 7.50 |
| none | one or more | none |
| none | none | none |

## What is counted

- **Calibration payments:** payments the customer made personally on the customer's calibration orders (a payment by any other payer is not counted), with an entry date less than 36 whole calendar months before the charge date.
- **Rental payments:** customer payments recorded on the customer's network rentals, with an entry date in the same window.
- The credit turns on whether each kind of payment exists in the window, not on how many there are or their amounts.

## Hypothetical illustrations

1. A customer paid for a Blind Spot Radar Calibration 10 months ago and paid a rental invoice share 20 months ago: USD 15.00.
2. A customer paid for a calibration 30 months ago and has no rental payment: USD 7.50.
3. A customer paid a rental share last year but made no calibration payment in the window: no credit.
